description: Enhanced edge cases for strict mode: a strict run mixing a passing scenario with an undefined one (run-level escalates to failed), and a strict run where every scenario passes (stays ok).

files.content:
Feature: Mixed
  Scenario: Good
    Given this step passes
  Scenario: Bad
    Given this step is undefined

cases.expected_output:
scenarios total=2 passed=1 failed=0 undefined=1 pending=0 skipped=0
steps total=2 passed=1 failed=0 undefined=1 pending=0 skipped=0
scenario keyword=Scenario name=Good line=2 status=passed
scenario keyword=Scenario name=Bad line=4 status=undefined
result=failed

files.content:
Feature: AllPass
  Scenario: One
    Given this step passes
  Scenario: Two
    Given this step passes

cases.expected_output:
scenarios total=2 passed=2 failed=0 undefined=0 pending=0 skipped=0

scenario keyword=Scenario name=One line=2 status=passed
